answer: The deadline to apply for special consideration is 11.55pm on the day your assessment is due or scheduled. Submit as soon as possible; applications can be made without supporting documents if you give a date for providing them.

points.text: Submit your application as soon as possible, but no later than 11.55pm on the day your assessment is due.
points.quote: Submit an application as soon as possible, but no later than 11.55pm on the day your assessment is due.
points.title: Extensions and special consideration

points.text: If you miss a lab or practical activity, the deadline is 11.55pm on the date of that missed activity, not the assessment date.
points.quote: You'll need to apply by 11.55pm on the date of the lab/practical activity you missed
points.title: Extensions and special consideration
points.section: Practical activities (including laboratories) and associated assessments

points.text: Not having your supporting documents ready is not a sufficient reason to apply late, but you can apply on time without them and state when you will provide them.
